title: 2 × enemigo: robot con rayo de protones

items.name: ProtonSentry
items.note: Centinela achaparrado de un ojo, cañón grueso al lado
items.prompt:
Generate ONE 2D game enemy sprite for a dark fantasy mobile roguelite: A hovering sentry robot with a squat rounded-box torso and a single big round visor eye, held up by a thruster. Side view facing right, full body, centered, SQUARE 1:1 image. One single character only: NOT a sprite sheet, no animation frames, no variations.

ART STYLE: Dark fantasy mobile game. Colour world of a frozen cave and ice crystal theme (colours only, not materials). Cold saturated palette of deep blues, icy whites, pale blue-grey stone and frosted steel. Cyan/turquoise accents only on crystals and eyes. Painted digital illustration, stylized semi-realistic, slight texture, no grain/haze outside the character.

CHARACTER: Matte steel-grey plating with pale ice-blue trim, chunky and friendly-menacing; short stubby antenna on the head; the proton beam cannon is a separate thick barrel with a glowing cyan lens at its tip, mounted beside the torso. A robotic floating machine, metal and mechanical (never an organic animal): it hovers because of a hover device (a thruster, jet or ring that blasts fire, vapour or energy downward). NO legs, NO feet, nothing touches the ground, it is airborne. Use the zone's colour palette only: its materials follow the creature's own nature (a robot stays metal, an animal stays an animal) and it is NOT covered in snow, ice, leaves or rock unless the design says so. It carries 1-3 glowing turquoise-cyan ice crystals: One ice crystal grows from the top of the head as an antenna, another sits on the cannon barrel as its power core.

ATTACK: It attacks with a WEAPON that fires its projectile (a cannon, gun, bow, launcher, blaster…). The weapon is its own separate piece, fully visible, held or mounted away from the other pieces, with the muzzle clearly visible and pointing to the RIGHT of the image. A weapon that is the end of an arm has no hand.

POSE (the character will be cut into separate pieces afterwards, so EVERY piece must be fully visible): Calm hovering pose, the body in the middle with the hover device clearly visible below or around it. The hover device is its own closed shape and is not hidden behind the body. Every piece of the body must be fully visible: no piece hides more than about 10% of another, and nothing covers a limb, the head or a joint. Each piece is one closed shape with its own full outline and a clearly visible contour where it touches the next one (the character is cut into separate pieces afterwards). Name sides by the image (the one on the LEFT / RIGHT of the image).

PIECES — exactly these 4, no more (no extra limbs, hands, weapons or loose parts; each piece joins its neighbour at a visible joint and has a clearly visible contour where they touch):
1. Body (torso, the machine's shell)
2. Head or sensor (only if the design has one)
3. Hover device (the thruster, jet or ring that holds it up; its flame, if any, is ONE flat colour inside its own outline)
4. Weapon (the part that fires the projectile; muzzle clearly visible, pointing right)

EDGE RULES (critical):
- Clean, crisp, hard silhouette with a 2px near-black outline all around, and a slightly darker contour line where pieces meet.
- NO glow, aura, halo, bloom, particles, snow, frost mist, dust, smoke, embers, blur or soft edges outside the outline. Crystal glow stays inside the silhouette.
- ABSOLUTELY NO effects of any kind: no energy beams, no muzzle flashes, no impact bursts, no motion lines. NO cast shadows, NO ground. A flame or glow that belongs to the body is one flat color inside its own outline.
- Background: perfectly flat, uniform pure white, zero gradient or noise, even if an attached reference image has sky or scenery. The character contains no pure white fill touching the background (use pale colors).
